name: EU Cookies Bar for WordPress
author: VillaTheme

sections.description:
EU Cookies Bar is a WordPress plugin that helps website owners to meet the obligations and rights enacted under the GDPR. The plugin allows visitors to accept a website to use their cookies, and also allow visitors to configure their cookies settings. General Data Protection Regulation – (GDPR) is a European regulation to strengthen and unify the data protection of EU citizens.

Try the Demo | Documents | Facebook group

Preview

How to install and use the plugin

FEATURES

► General:

  • Agreement duration: Set expiry date for an agreement after a user accepts

  • Block until accepting: An option to enable cookies only after visitor accepts to use, for those who want their website comply with the new EU Cookies Law-GDPR

  • Strictly necessary cookies: Specify very important cookies that can not be disabled by your visitors

  • Strictly necessary cookies prefix: Cookies whose names start with these prefixes can not be disable by your visitors too

  • Your privacy policy: This is to let your visitors know what your website uses cookies for beside a list of cookies that your website uses

► Cookies bar:

  • Message: Easy to change/edit front-end message with WordPress editor

  • Button decline: Let your visitors able to accept or decline your privacy policy, this is one of what GDPR requires

  • Button close: Just another option

  • Cookies bar position: Can be top, bottom, bottom left or bottom right, not many but enough

  • Implicit behaviors: Close cookies bar, accept or decline when your visitors hit close button, scroll their mouse wheel or refresh the browser. Depending on which cookies/privacy law you have to comply with, use this option flexibly to make the cookies bar less annoyed

  • Cookies bar design: You can change cookies bar font-size, text color, background color or opacity to make it in harmony with your theme, and a custom css field is available for your own customization

► Visitor cookies settings:

  • GDPR requires your website to have this

  • This is a small popup box that show your privacy and cookies policy and a list of available cookies that your website uses

  • Visitors can view and edit to accept which cookies on the list whenever they want, even before or after they accept to use cookies

  • A very small bar on the bottom which will show the visitors cookies settings when they click on it, and also a helpful shortcode [eucookiesbar_settings]”your text”[/eucookiesbar_settings] to call the cookies settings which you can place wherever you want in case you don’t want the small bar to be there

PREMIUM FEATURE

► General settings:

  • Multilingual support and language detection

  • Cookie rejection expiration period

  • Integration with Google Tag Manager (GTM)

  • Integration with Meta Pixel for tracking

► Cookies settings:

  • Ability to display cookies on both frontend and backend

  • Scan cookies to detect and list all cookies in use on your site

  • Add and delete cookies as needed

  • Edit cookie details, such as name, category, duration, and description

  • Organize cookies into categories

  • Create and manage cookie categories, including setting up names, descriptions, and assigning cookies

  • Mark certain cookies, such as strictly necessary ones, as “Always Active”

  • Add or remove categories as needed

  • Rearrange cookie categories by dragging and dropping them

► Cookie Bar:

  • Control the delay before the cookie bar appears

  • Dismiss the cookie bar after a timeout period

  • Use conditional tags to control when and where the cookie bar appears

  • Customize the design and appearance of the privacy button

  • Set a header title for the cookie bar

► Settings Popup:

  • Choose from different layout options for the settings popup

  • Display cookies in a list format or with tabs

  • Add custom icons to the settings popup

  • Adjust the opacity of the popup

  • Option to hide content from characters

  • Enable or disable the cookie list

  • Show or hide cookie descriptions

  • Hide specific cookie categories from the list

  • Customize the save, accept, reject button with options for enabling/disabling, color, background color…

  • Edit the overview tab header, cookies list label, and cookie name/description column labels

  • Set custom labels for the “Always Active” and “Active Cookie” sections

  • Modify the description under the overview tab

► Floating Icon:

  • Position the floating icon on the page

  • Choose the icon to be displayed for quick access to cookie settings

► Other Features:

  • Access and view activity logs to monitor user interactions with the cookie consent mechanism

  • Generate detailed reports on cookie consent performance

sections.installation:
1. Unzip the download package
  2. Upload eu-cookies-bar to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
